texts:
Executive Statement
Staged-flux treatment lowers residual turbidity without a settled seasonal claim.

Hypothesis and context
North Basin treatment works · 10 weekly blocks · Standard vs staged-flux arm · endpoint: residual turbidity (NTU) at discharge.

Week 1 to week 10 residual
2.14 NTU → 1.42 NTU

Interpretation
Across ten paired blocks, staged-flux residual turbidity fell faster after week 4. Median flux retention is also higher, while the cold-water weeks widen both arms. The trial was not powered for a seasonal reliability claim and the two missed inflow samples were imputed from the prior shift.

Recommendation
Extend the staged-flux trial to one basin
The paired result is promising but seasonal inflow and two imputed samples limit generalization; retain the standard train as the control.
Pilot

Executive Statement
Corridor 7 is available, with a recurring East Junction reset risk.

Report context
Corridor 7 · 12 handoff intervals · 4 interlock zones · runbook 7C-OPS-184 · data frozen at 21:30 local.

Shift interpretation
Aggregate route availability recovered from 98.1% to 99.2% after relay replacement, but East Junction still accounts for 14 of 19 resets. The four-zone sample masks one intermittently stale axle-counter channel; the overnight possession is a useful verification window but does not establish a durable repair.

Evidence Card
Relay change reduced resets in the paired interval
East Junction remains the only zone with repeat resets; a stale channel may hide one event.
Open

Risk Callout
Keep East Junction under supervised release
Fault recurrence is localized but the reset trend and stale channel conflict; do not close the corrective action on aggregate availability alone.
Monitor

Project Card
Corridor 7 East Junction watch
Owner: Rail Systems Operations · possession 2026-09-27 01:00 · evidence due before route release.
In progress

texts:
Hero Title
Stage the Tidal Gate fleet by basin; sensor drift prevents a full green release.

Mean load: Marsh 4 vs East Sluice
71% → 58%

Body Narrative
Storm readiness · Tidal Gate basin network · 14 six-hour intervals · three pump stations · field telemetry export 2026-09-22 06:00. Marsh 4 carried the highest sustained load and vibration spread, while East Sluice telemetry stayed below the intake threshold after a sensor swap. One high-load interval is disputed between the supervisory historian and a local counter. Deploy two stations now and hold Marsh 4 for a bearing check; this report does not infer storm intensity from pump duty alone.

Risk Callout
Stage two stations; hold Marsh 4 for verification
Historian and local counter disagree for interval 2026-09-21 18:00–24:00; sensor drift remains a deployment risk.
Conditional

Key Takeaway
Next step: assign East Sluice and Delta Yard to the first response wave; release Marsh 4 after vibration and counter reconciliation.

Body Narrative
Storm readiness · Tidal Gate basin network · 14 six-hour intervals · three pump stations · field telemetry export 2026-09-22 06:00. Marsh 4 carried the highest sustained load and vibration spread, while East Sluice telemetry stayed below the intake threshold after a sensor swap. One high-load interval is disputed between the supervisory historian and a local counter. Deploy two stations now and hold Marsh 4 for a bearing check; this report does not infer storm intensity from pump duty alone.

texts:
Hero Title
Activate one Saffron Link micro-hub for the late sailing window.

Baseline vs pilot dwell
18 h → 14.2 h

Body Narrative
Saffron Link citrus export · four destination lanes · 7-day pilot sample · cold-chain telemetry as of 2026-09-24. The pilot reduced median dwell while temperature excursions stayed below the contract limit. The humidity sensor reads 3–5 points high after calibration, so spoilage risk is not fully cleared. Four lanes are too few to claim network-wide savings; treat the activation as a reversible one-week decision.

Risk Callout
Approve one-week Harbor East activation
Temperature stayed inside contract limits; humidity calibration bias keeps spoilage exposure uncertain. Keep the fallback routing available.
Reversible

Key Takeaway
Next step: activate Harbor East for one week, verify humidity calibration on day two, and stop if any lane exceeds 6.0°C for 20 minutes.
